scientific_conclusion: Retained runs support the redirect toward evidence calibration: strong tool-enabled agents often match central diagnosis once evidence access is fair, deterministic checking trades unsupported-claim risk against coverage, and old semantic judges are sensitive to evidence closure and causal scope. They do not establish a new B4-versus-B2 effect.
